requirement: Tune the regularization of a scaled logistic regression on imbalanced data with a grid search that is stratified, reproducible from a seed, scored by macro F1, and refitted on all data.
skeleton: A fold count and parameter grid, and a tune function validating class counts, building a scaler plus classifier Pipeline, a seeded shuffled StratifiedKFold, and a refitting GridSearchCV.
caption: Tuning a scikit-learn pipeline on imbalanced labels with a reproducible grid search. N_SPLITS is 5 and PARAM_GRID searches clf__C over 0.01, 0.1, 1.0 and 10.0. tune(x, y, *, seed=0) counts the classes with numpy and raises ValueError saying it needs two or more classes with N_SPLITS or more samples each when there is one class or any class is rarer than the fold count. It builds a Pipeline of StandardScaler as scale and LogisticRegression with max_iter 1000 as clf, a StratifiedKFold with N_SPLITS, shuffle on and random_state seed, and a GridSearchCV over the pipeline and grid with scoring f1_macro, that cv and refit on, then returns the fitted search. The fixture asserts that the best pipeline is refitted with its scale and clf steps and the chosen C from the grid, that the mean test score equals macro F1 recomputed over the folds, that the folds equal a shuffled StratifiedKFold with the given seed, and that one class or a rare class raises ValueError.

constraints: One class or a class rarer than the fold count raises ValueError
The search scores candidates with macro F1
Folds are stratified, shuffled and seeded by the seed argument
Grid keys address the classifier step as clf__C
The best pipeline is refitted on all data

rationale.teaches: Search pipeline hyperparameters with step-prefixed grid keys, an explicit seeded StratifiedKFold, an imbalance-aware scorer, and refit enabled.
rationale.why: Accuracy rewards predicting the majority class, unseeded or unshuffled folds make results irreproducible, and without refit there is no best estimator to deploy.

ops.docstring: Tune a scaled logistic regression with a seeded, stratified grid search.

candidates.why_wrong: Candidates are ranked by accuracy, which favours the majority class.
StratifiedKFold without shuffle rejects the random_state and the search never runs.
Without refit the search exposes no best_estimator_ to predict with.
Single-class labels pass validation and fail later inside scikit-learn.
The seed argument is ignored so every call uses the same folds.
